1 · Intro

When to use it.

Some states require job postings to show a pay range. Vanderbilt posts ranges only where required: New York and California.

Location decides it. The location on the position flows to the requisition and the posting, so it must name the real place, never just United States.

Use this whenYou are creating a position or requisition for a job in, or reporting into, New York or California.

2 · Walk through

How to decide.

Check off each item as you read.

Where Vanderbilt posts pay ranges
LocationPost a range?
New York (or reports into New York)Yes
California (or may be filled in California)Yes
Other locationsNo, unless a new requirement applies

Watch-outs

  • A remote job reporting to a New York supervisor is covered even if the person lives elsewhere.
  • Open item: confirm with your engagement consultant (EC) how Vanderbilt handles postings open to multiple locations or remote anywhere.
  • Open item: confirm with your EC whether other states or cities where Vanderbilt hires have new pay transparency rules.

HCM Academy job aid · Regional and Out-of-State Hiring

Pay transparency

Use when: You are creating a position or requisition for a job in, or reporting into, New York or California. · System: Oracle Recruiting

  1. Set a specific location on the position.
  2. New York: post a range if the job is in New York or reports there.
    • The range must be a good faith estimate at the time of posting.
    • No open-ended ranges, such as $20 an hour and up.
  3. California: include the pay scale in the posting itself.
  4. Get the range from Compensation.
  5. Check the posting before it goes live.
Where Vanderbilt posts pay ranges
LocationPost a range?
New York (or reports into New York)Yes
California (or may be filled in California)Yes
Other locationsNo, unless a new requirement applies

Watch-outs

  • A remote job reporting to a New York supervisor is covered even if the person lives elsewhere.
  • Open item: confirm with your engagement consultant (EC) how Vanderbilt handles postings open to multiple locations or remote anywhere.
  • Open item: confirm with your EC whether other states or cities where Vanderbilt hires have new pay transparency rules.
